app.name: DengueWatch BD
app.tagline: Report Aedes breeding sites. See them cleared.
app.description: Citizens report standing water where Aedes mosquitoes breed. Ward teams clear it and close each site with a photo.
app.offline: You are offline. Reports will be sent when you are back online.

home.ctaHint: Takes under 30 seconds. No sign-up needed.
home.step1: Take a photo of standing water: tires, buckets, drums, AC trays, flower tubs, rooftops, drains, construction sites.
home.step2: Pin the location. Tell us if you saw larvae.
home.step3: Your ward team gets it in their queue and must close it with an on-site photo.
home.step4: Follow progress on the public map and ward scorecards.
home.cleanBody: Empty the water, scrub the inside, and cover or turn it upside down. Aedes eggs stick to container walls for months.
home.queued: {count, plural, one {# report waiting to upload} other {# reports waiting to upload}}
home.emergency: Fever? Visit a hospital or call the national health helpline 16263. This app does not diagnose dengue.

risk.explain: Ward risk is estimated from satellite vegetation, water, built-up area and surface temperature, plus rainfall, reports and official case counts. Satellites cannot see containers; this only ranks wards for where to look first.

report.title: Report a breeding site
report.photoHint: Show the water clearly. Avoid faces and number plates.
report.modelSkipped: Photo checker skipped on this device. A volunteer will review it.
report.tooDark: The photo looks very dark. Retake with more light?
report.tooBlurry: The photo looks blurry. Hold still and retake?
report.looksGood: Looks like a possible breeding site.
report.looksUnclear: We could not tell. That is fine; a volunteer will check it.
report.notRelevantBody: This photo does not look like standing water. You can still send it.
report.locationHint: Drag the map so the pin sits on the spot.
report.locationDenied: Location permission is off. Move the map to the spot manually.
report.larvaeLabel: Did you see larvae (small wrigglers) in the water?
report.selfCleaned: I emptied or cleaned it myself
report.notePlaceholder: e.g. behind the tea stall, 3rd floor roof
report.noteHint: Do not write names or phone numbers.
report.privacy: Your photo is checked before anything is shown publicly. Faces and number plates are blurred, and the public map shows only an approximate location (about 50 m).
report.errorGeneric: Could not send. Your report is saved and will be retried.
report.rateLimited: You have sent many reports recently. Please try again later.
report.otpRequired: Please verify your phone number to keep reporting.
report.queuedOffline: Saved offline. It will upload automatically when you are online.

done.title: Thank you!
done.body: Your report was sent to the ward team.
done.queuedBody: We will send it as soon as you are online.
done.cleanTitle: Cleaned it yourself? Great. Next time:
done.tip1: Empty all water and scrub the inside wall: eggs stick there.
done.tip2: Turn buckets, tires and pots upside down or cover them.
done.tip3: Change water in flower vases and AC trays every 3 days.
done.tip4: Put sand in plant saucers so water cannot stand.
done.shareText: I just reported a mosquito breeding site on DengueWatch BD. Check your roof, balcony and AC tray too!
done.notify: Notify me when it is cleared
done.notifyOn: You will get a notification when the status changes.
done.notifyUnsupported: Notifications are not supported on this browser.
done.tipsTitle: Keep your home free of breeding sites:

mine.title: My reports
mine.empty: You have not sent any reports from this device yet.

map.title: Map
map.noBoundaries: Ward boundaries are not loaded yet.

auth.notStaff: This account has no staff role yet. Ask your ward admin for an invite.

mod.title: Moderation queue
mod.mergeHint: Paste the site ID to merge this site into.
mod.shortcuts: Keyboard: A approve · R reject · 1–8 type · M merge · J/K next/previous

insp.empty: No open sites in your ward.
insp.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. container already removed, wrong location
insp.afterPhotoHint: Required. Take it at the site: your location must be within 50 m.
insp.distance: You are {meters} m from the site
insp.tooFar: Too far from the site ({meters} m). Move closer and retake.
insp.sortedBy: Sorted by ward risk and age
insp.gpsNeeded: Location is needed to close a site.

admin.title: Admin
admin.wardsHint: Upload a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Each feature needs properties city_corp (DNCC or DSCC) and ward_no.
admin.casesHint: Use this when the DGHS bulletin scraper fails. Manual entries are not overwritten by the scraper.
admin.inviteSent: Invite saved. They can sign in with this email.
admin.name: Name

data.title: Open data
data.body: Anonymised site data is free to use under ODbL-compatible terms. Locations are snapped to about 50 m; no reporter information is included.
data.research: Researchers: sign in for the report-level anonymised export.

about.title: About DengueWatch BD
about.body: An open-source civic project. Citizens report possible Aedes breeding sites; city corporation ward teams clear them; everyone can see the follow-through. We complement Mosquito Alert (icddr,b), which collects mosquito photos.
about.satellite: Satellites cannot see container-sized breeding sites. We use them only to rank wards by environmental risk.
